description: Smarte Strasse: Geschwindigkeitsmessungen is a dataset listed in Datenportal Basel-Stadt open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Amt für Umwelt und Energie. Der Datensatz zeigt Geschwindigkeit und Lautstärke von Fahrzeugen mit der dazugehörigen Zeitangabe. Aus Datenschutzgründen werden jeweils Gruppen von 20 Fahrzeugen gebildet, die Reihenfolge randomisiert, und nur nur jeweils Start- und Endzeitpunkt des jeweiligen Zeitintervalls angegeben. Wichtig: Die Geschwindigkeits-Werte vor dem 25.03.2022 um 11:35 Uhr sind nicht kalibriert. Coverage: Canton of Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under Mobility and Transport. Its keywords are Smarte Strasse, Tempo, Lärm, Lautstärke, Auto. The portal shows 2,350,606 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2024-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bs-ch-portal.
